selectionPolicy: Start at first blank-line paragraph boundary at or after floor(full extracted UTF16 length /4); then take three consecutive ranges <=2048 UTF16 units, preferring the last paragraph boundary in second half, else last whitespace in second half, else scalar-safe hard boundary. No content/parse-result selection.
scope: Exact selected-text/token spans and structural adapter acceptance only. Does not measure OCR accuracy, English/NER accuracy, legal meaning, authority, or whole-document completeness. No quotations, copyrighted text, source URLs or raw exception messages in this report.

refusal.reason: Adapter exported integer indices without Enhanced++ copy-node identities; a projected self edge and duplicate edge were refused. No edges erased.
